900.3.10(925).explanation: Site-specific RD exception 925: the minimum lot frontage and lot area are those that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted; side yard setback 1.2 m (4.5 m where the side lot line abuts a street); a garage 0.3 m from an interior side lot line; required parking inside the house; the lands must also comply with exception 900.3.10(1462); and 16 Belgreen Ave. has a 5.0 m front setback.

900.3.10(1249).explanation: Site-specific RD exception 1249: on a lot with a 0.6 FSI limit, a detached house built before October 15, 1953 may get a rear addition up to a total FSI of 0.69 if the addition stays at or below the existing top floor level, keeps the existing side wall line, and any earlier addition is at least 5 years old; raised front or rear platforms may not encroach into the required yard; and lots 7.6 m wide or narrower may not have a vehicle entrance through the front wall.

900.3.10(86).explanation: Site-specific RD exception 86: the minimum lot frontage and lot area are those that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted; buildings must be 22.0 m from the original centreline of Bellamy Rd. and 30.0 m from that of Lawrence Ave.; side yard setback 1.2 m (3.6 m where the side lot line abuts a street); and a garage must be at least 0.3 m from a side lot line.
